meta.phase-name: Shared Level Schema and Codegen Implementation

phase-summary.outcome: The shared level-centered schema is implemented in the engine, generated from checked-in source documents, included in release artifacts, and round-trippable through the docs-site import/export flow.

file.description: Defines level kinds, nested authored structures, level browser payloads, and dungeon-layout projection from level content.
Extends schema document handling to recognize and build level-content documents.
Checked-in authored source document for dungeon floors, region examples, dungeon-region examples, and run definitions.
Generates runtime level-content data from checked-in source documents.
Generates manifest/report/index plus level-content document and level-browser payload artifacts.
Accepts level-content patches and emits the generated artifacts through the browser bundle path.

decision.summary: The generated level browser payload includes each run's ordered `levelIds`, not just start and escape ids.
decision.impact: Docs-site and Unreal consumers can filter and inspect a whole run without reloading the full authored document format.

next.action: Use the generated level-content outputs in docs-site authoring surfaces, gameplay consumers, and the Unreal plugin browser.
